facts.text: I think it is important for law enforcement to take the initiative to engage with the community rather than only waiting for residents to come forward with concerns.
I completely agree that it is important for both residents and law enforcement to work together to make communities safer.
I believe working together creates a sense of ownership and accountability for everyone.
I feel it is especially important for young people to get involved and take ownership of their neighborhoods.

keyphrases: residents and law enforcement working together
